message.content:
Here’s a quick reference for the long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023 (dates that fall on a weekday will create a three‑day weekend; if they fall on a weekend, the following Monday is usually observed):

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Observed (if applicable) | Notes |
|---------|-------------|---------------------------|-------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 (Sunday) | Jan 2 (Monday) |  |
| Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Feb 20 (Monday) |  |  |
| Louis Riel Day (Manitoba) | Feb 20 (Monday) |  |  |
| Heritage Day (New Brunswick) | Feb 20 (Monday) |  |  |
| St. Patrick’s Day (Nova Scotia) | Mar 17 (Friday) |  |  |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 (Friday) |  |  |
| Easter Monday (Quebec, Nunavut, Northwest Territories) | Apr 10 (Monday) |  |  |
| Victoria Day | May 22 (Monday) |  |  |
| National Indigenous Peoples Day (Northwest Territories, Nunavut) | Jun 21 (Wednesday) |  |  |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 (Saturday) | Jul 3 (Monday) |  |
| Civic Holiday (Ontario, Prince Edward Island, Nova Scotia, New Brunswick) | Aug 7 (Monday) |  |  |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 (Monday) |  |  |
| Thanksgiving (Canada) | Oct 9 (Monday) |  |  |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 (Saturday) | Nov 13 (Monday) |  |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 (Monday) |  |  |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 (Tuesday) |  |  |

**Long‑weekends (three‑day stretches)**  
- **Jan 1–3** (New Year’s Day observed on Jan 2)  
- **Feb 20–22** (Family Day / Louis Riel Day / Heritage Day)  
- **Mar 17–19** (St. Patrick’s Day)  
- **Apr 7–10** (Good Friday + Easter Monday) – note that Easter Monday is only observed in Quebec, Nunavut, and the Northwest Territories.  
- **May 22–24** (Victoria Day)  
- **Jun 21–23** (National Indigenous Peoples Day) – only in the Northwest Territories and Nunavut.  
- **Jul 1–3** (Canada Day observed on Jul 3)  
- **Aug 7–9** (Civic Holiday) – only in Ontario, Prince Edward Island, Nova Scotia, and New Brunswick.  
- **Sep 4–6** (Labour Day)  
- **Oct 9–11** (Thanksgiving)  
- **Nov 11–13** (Remembrance Day observed on Nov 13) – only in the Northwest Territories and Nunavut.  
- **Dec 25–27** (Christmas & Boxing Day)

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the same information broken down by province or if you need it formatted differently for your app!
